thread:
maria: kicking off the new eu-edge project account + network prep. I pushed the initial terraform skeleton to infra-account-templates. Can folks sanity-check the CIDR plan?

aj: saw the commit, checking now. which region are we targeting again? eu-west4?

maria: correct — eu-west4 (edge region). goal is 2 GPU node pools (p4d-equivalent) behind the private subnet, with a dedicated mgmt VPC peered to prod for ops hooks.

chris: quick note — cloud provider quota for GPUs in that region is small by default. We need to request quota and quota increase before we can land the pools. Submitted a ticket to account team: https://cloud.example.com/q/INC-5421

maria: thanks. ticket ID noted. timeline?

chris: they said 48–72h in best case. for validation we can mock with a single small instance and run the network checks.

aj: re: CIDR, current proposal is 10.50.0.0/16 for service VPC, split into: 10.50.0.0/24 mgmt, 10.50.1.0/22 gpu-private, 10.50.8.0/22 worker-cache. That leaves room for later /16 expansions. Any objections?

maria: looks good. Make sure the /24 mgmt doesn't overlap with partner peering blocks — Devon, can you confirm partner CIDRs?

devon: partner announced 10.51.0.0/16, so no overlap. Also they asked for a transit subnet to host NAT + bastion ip(s). Suggest 10.50.254.0/24 for transit.

aj: updated terraform variables accordingly. snippet:```hcl
variable "region" { default = "eu-west4" }
module "vpc" { source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra/vpc-module.git"
  cidr = "10.50.0.0/16"
  subnets = { mgmt = "10.50.0.0/24" gpu = "10.50.1.0/22" transit = "10.50.254.0/24" }
}```

maria: nice. two validation items before handoff: 1) confirm quota is approved, 2) run the smoke plan/apply in staging account and run e2e netchecks (bastion -> gpu nodes, NAT egress, peering routes).

chris: I'll coordinate quota follow-up. Once quota is in, I'll create a tiny nodepool (1x) with GPU to validate driver install + kubelet config.

devon: for e2e netchecks I'll prepare this script to run from bastion (quick curl + ssh checks):```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# check routing to worker
nc -zv 10.50.1.5 22 -w 3 || echo \"ssh port unreachable\"
# egress test
curl -sS https://ifconfig.co || echo \"egress failed\"
# kv cache access test to redis service
curl -sS http://10.50.8.10:6379/ping || echo \"cache unreachable\"
```

aj: one more: make sure subnet tags/labels include: "redwood:env=eu-edge", "redwood:role=gpu" so routing/observability picks them up. I'll add policy check in CI.

maria: perfect. handoff checklist draft for ops (for the region owner to sign off):
- account credentials + billing assigned
- GPU quota approval ticket closed
- terraform state for account configured (remote backend)
- applied VPC with subnets & transit
- peering configured to prod-mgmt and partner networks
- smoke nodepool created and kubelet+driver validated
- NAT/bastion verified by e2e script
- cost estimate for steady-state 2 pools + buffer shared

chris: on cost estimate — rough numbers: baseline steady-state for 2x p4-like pools with 8 instances each ~ $27k/month. Add 20% for buffer = ~$32k/month. I'll put exact SKU numbers in the ticket.

maria: great. final step: once all green, we do a 1hr handoff call with platform & SRE to flip routing policies and add region to monitoring. Who can own the call?

devon: I can run it Thurs 09:00 UTC if that works for everyone.

aj: works for me.

chris: Thurs OK. I'll update the ticket with quota ETA by EOD.

sre-bot: reminder: run infra-net-scan after apply. Use command: `./scripts/net-scan --region eu-west4 --targets 10.50.0.0/16`

maria: thanks all — assigning action items in the PR and will link the handoff checklist. If anything blocks, drop updates here and tag @maria. :thumbsup:
